company.shortDescription: Photoroom is an AI-enabled image capturing app that offers image retouching, background removal, and batch editing services.
company.description: Photoroom is an AI-enabled image capturing app that lets users create studio-quality product pictures in seconds. The company offers to remove background, change the background, and showcase products in one click on iPhone and iPad for free, helping users to easily make changes to their images.

productsAndServices.description: Collaboration and brand-management functionality for sharing logos, colors, templates, and designs to produce consistent on-brand visuals across a team.
productsAndServices.name: Photoroom Brand Kit and Teams

productsAndServices.description: An enterprise offering that provides Photoroom’s visual-creation capabilities for established organizations requiring team workflows, custom integrations, reliability, and administrative control.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $43,000,000, or 69.22% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,044,555 to $500,000,000, a 123.62x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
